    Irreducible maps and binary biproducts #

    This file formalizes the standard Butler--Ringel observation that two irreducible maps from one local object assemble to an irreducible map into a binary biproduct when every morphism between the two target summands is categorically radical. The dual statement treats a binary-biproduct source.
